title: 二次确认
summary: 二次确认不是一律弹窗。打断程度与认知摩擦，必须与后果的不可逆性及影响范围严格成正比。
summaryEn: Confirmations should not be a one-size-fits-all modal. Interruption weight and cognitive friction must strictly scale with irreversibility and scope of consequence.
asks: 执行破坏性操作时，该用多重的二次确认？
asksEn: How heavy should the confirmation be for a destructive action?

links.when: 破坏性确认阶梯不是浮层贴附分类
links.whenEn: destructive confirmation ladder is not overlay anchoring

links.when: 二次确认拦截机制不是按钮视觉层级
links.whenEn: confirmation safeguard is not button visual hierarchy

links.when: 事后撤销窗口不是网络失败回滚
links.whenEn: post-action undo window is not network error rollback

links.when: 长按确认防误触不是长按激活多选
